# The Technological Society

*[Jacques Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) · 1954*

The first part of [Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md)'s trilogy on technique, almost unnoticed in France and made known by its American translation (1964). Technique is defined there as the pursuit of maximal efficiency in every field, and described as autonomous, self-augmenting and universal.
